text: The account and balance read of rwb-source-data, the rwb-case state read and move answer, the DEBTSALE package read of rwb-decision and the posting item of rwb-integration are consumed on their owners' published contracts, never as tables, views or direct endpoints, and their operation names stay placeholders until the owners publish them.
why: Only rwb-source-data holds the recovery.v_ace_* views, only rwb-case writes recovery_case, only rwb-decision governs the rule rows and only rwb-integration owns the interface to ALS and the general ledger. TSD S6 T5.1 names INT-25 only and publishes no operation name for these rows, so no name may be invented; the plan's C row for the slice is empty, so the rows are class C dependencies in fact and not in the metadata.

applied_in: RWB-S6-E6008-APP metadata, sections 2, 3, 4, 12.2, 12.8 and 13; RWB-S6-E6008-CON metadata, sections 2, 3, 7 AC3, 11, 12.2 and 13
confirm: Solution architect and the owners of rwb-source-data, rwb-case, rwb-decision and rwb-integration, before the contract is tagged
impact: Both stories build on Day 1 against five contract fakes with a 2 s budget and a breaker, and a statement on a v_ace_* view, a recovery_case row or an interface table fails the boundary test

text: DP-05 is applied as the owner's contract: the account, balance and ALS facts of the transferred accounts are read on rwb-source-data's operations with the as-of date of the product, the case state and the case move are rwb-case's, and this service holds no v_ace_* grant and no case write.
why: DP-05 offers two readings, the owner's contract or the service's own ACE views, and the architecture gives the 30 recovery.v_ace_* views to rwb-source-data alone. The legacy Data table names v_ace_account and recovery_case as the step's inputs, so the facts are needed but may not be read as tables.

impact: The stale-product path VR-S6-012-1 with MSG-P1-001 is decided on the owner's as-of date, and no ACE view is granted to this service

The step starts from the transfer of the lot and the month-end timer of R-DS-31, and a published event here would be a business value invented by the builder. DP-09 is absent from the pattern set of this key.

DP-16 is not in this key's pattern set, so the interface is consumed and not built, and no source in the read set gives its values or its result codes.

text: The posting of R-DS-31 and the re-post of R-DS-33 run unattended under the rwb-debtsale service identity, because TSD S6 T6.1 gives RW-CREDITAD the Debt sale right R only, and the Credit Administration officer reads the outcome and works the two-working-day exception task of R-DS-32.
